Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Music Kweku Flick teams up with Shatta Wale on new single ‘Sweet’ Source : Joy Entertainment 22 October 2026 11:08am Audio By Carbonatix
Ghanaian musician Kweku Flick has teamed up with Shatta Wale on a new single titled Sweet , which explores resilience, confidence and the pursuit of success.
Produced by Khendi Beats, Sweet is a street-inspired song featuring a hard-hitting beat that complements the energy of both artists.
The lyrics paint a picture of survivors and hustlers navigating dangerous streets with discipline and focus.
The collaboration marks a significant moment for Kweku Flick, who is entering a new chapter with his ‘Sweet Boy’ era. The rebrand signals growth, maturity and a renewed artistic direction, one that blends street credibility with mainstream appeal.
Shatta Wale’s feature brings his signature energy and large fanbase to the record.
Together, the two artists create a sound that draws on Ghanaian musical influences while appealing to a wider audience.
